newsitem.title: INDIA: Guerrillas shoot dead journalist in Kashmir.
newsitem.headline: Guerrillas shoot dead journalist in Kashmir.

text.p: Unidentified guerrillas shot dead an Indian television journalist on Sunday in the troubled Himalayan region of Kashmir, police said. They said Sydan Shafi, a journalist working for an Indian television network, and his bodyguard were killed in Srinagar, the summer capital of India's northern state of Jammu and Kashmir.
Kashmiri journalists have become targets of separatists' attacks in recent years.
Separatist Moslem guerrillas took 19 local journalists hostage last July and threatened to kill four of them unless their editors agreed to meet them. They were later released unharmed.
A parcel bomb killed a Kashmiri journalist and wounded two others in September 1995.

Dozens of guerrilla groups in Kashmir are fighting for independence or merger with neighbouring Pakistan. Police and hospitals say more than 20,000 people have been killed since the violence began in 1990.
